subject: PO / invoicing recipient and tax handling — order-form redline request
messages:
From: Tariq Ahmed <tariq@novamed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novamed.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Order form questions — invoicing recipient & tax handling

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — team is keen to move forward. Procurement has a few outstanding commercial items on the Order Form and the MSA redlines we need clarified before we can issue a PO:

1) Invoice recipient: Novamed requires invoices to list the US operating entity (Novamed, Inc.) as the bill-to for 3rd party accounting reasons. Can Redwood accept the invoice recipient being Novamed, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789) while the SOW references Novamed UK Ltd for service delivery in EMEA?

2) Payment terms: our standard is Net45 for platform contracts. Can you confirm you can accept Net45 and include a 30-day grace for any activation invoice?

3) Taxes & withholdings: in certain APAC/EU jurisdictions our finance team will apply statutory withholding. We need language that allows us to withhold locally and receive a credit note or gross-up as appropriate.

4) PO & line items: procurement requires PO number on each invoice and explicit line items matching the pricing buckets for minimum commit tiers.

Attached is the PO draft (Novamed_PO_5678.pdf). Please send the redlined Order Form and any suggested MSA edits for legal review. If helpful we can run a quick call tomorrow to align.

Best,
Tariq
Head of Procurement
Novamed
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Tariq Ahmed <tariq@novamed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order form questions — invoicing recipient & tax handling

Tariq — really appreciate the clear list. High level response and next steps below: 

• Invoice recipient: we can invoice Novamed, Inc. as the bill-to while the SOW references the UK entity. We will need legal to adjust invoice recipient fields and confirm invoicing entity mapping.

• Payment terms: we typically run Net30, but for customers with enterprise procurement we can accept Net45. Will confirm final position with finance.

• Taxes & withholdings: Redwood's standard is to not gross-up for customer withholdings; we can provide credit notes where appropriate and work with you on supporting tax documentation (W-8/W-9 where needed). Legal to propose language that captures both EU reverse-charge and APAC statutory withholdings.

• PO & line items: will produce an Order Form with explicit pricing buckets and a PO field on each invoice. Grace — can you confirm we can add PO line mapping and a PO number requirement to the Order Form PDF?

Attached: Ill upload the redline we propose once legal gives the go-ahead. Quick call tomorrow at 10am PT works if that's possible — will send calendar invite.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order form questions — invoicing recipient & tax handling

Ben / team — legal reviewed Tariq's asks and prepared a set of targeted edits. Summary of proposed redlines (see attached Redwood_MSA_redline_kp_20261104.pdf and Redwood_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf):

1) Invoice recipient mapping — add explicit billing contact block in the Order Form: 
   - Bill-To (required): [Company legal name + tax id]
   - Remit-To (for payment processing): [entity name / bank details]
   This allows the service SOW to reference a different operational entity while invoices flow to Novamed, Inc.

2) Payment terms — We can accept Net45 for this deal subject to: (a) activation invoice payable Net30 (customer asked for grace — we agreed to 30-day grace on activation only), and (b) late payment interest at statutory rate after 60 days. Please confirm with finance on interest threshold.

3) Taxes — Add clause: "Customer shall be responsible for applicable taxes and statutory withholdings unless Redwood is required by law to collect VAT/GST. In jurisdictions where Customer applies withholding tax, Customer shall provide documentation of withheld amounts and Redwood will issue a credit note for the withheld amount following receipt of proof." This balances risk while allowing credit notes.

4) Withholdings/gross-up — legal will not accept a blanket gross-up obligation from Redwood. If Novamed requests gross-up, we need to capture that as a commercial credit or price adjustment in the Order Form.

5) PO on invoice & line items — agree to include PO number on invoice and pricing-bucket line mapping. Finance to confirm invoice template.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_redline_kp_20261104.pdf (redlines with comment balloons) and a draft Order Form redline. If Procurement has redline suggestions, please have them send tracked edits back.

-Kim
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Tariq Ahmed <tariq@novamed.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novamed.com>, Lara Singh <lara.singh@novamed.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order form questions — invoicing recipient & tax handling

Kim / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement reviewed the redlines and we have the following counterpoints: 

• Invoice recipient: Novamed can accept separate remit-to/bill-to fields, but requirement stands that the bill-to must be Novamed, Inc. for all invoices tied to this PO. Please ensure the invoice template will persist that field.

• Payment terms: Net45 is acceptable — procurement will add an internal approval for Net45. The activation invoice should be treated as "first month" and payment due Net45 as well. The 30-day grace language creates internal AR complexity; we would prefer a consistent Net45 across invoices.

• Taxes & withholdings: we can provide documentation for statutory withholdings; however, we need assurance that Redwood will issue a credit note within 30 days of receiving proof of withholding. If Redwood cannot commit to a 30-day credit note turnaround, we need a holdback / escrow proposal.

• Gross-up: Novamed cannot accept price increases to cover gross-up. If Redwood insists on no gross-up, please confirm the credit note path is sufficient operationally.

• PO & line items: confirmed — procurement will require PO number visible on every invoice. Also requesting one-line description per pricing bucket (min commit, overage).

We can sign off quickly if Redwood confirms (a) invoice will show Bill-To: Novamed, Inc., (b) Net45 for all invoices, and (c) credit note issued within 30 days upon receipt of withholding proof. If needed we can set a short call to close.

Regards,
Tariq
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Tariq Ahmed <tariq@novamed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order form questions — invoicing recipient & tax handling

Tariq — thanks. Final operational commitments from Redwood: 

1) Invoice: we will add explicit Bill-To and Remit-To fields. Bill-To will be set to Novamed, Inc. for this deal.
2) Payment terms: Redwood accepts consistent Net45 across invoices for this agreement (including activation invoice).
3) Credit notes: Redwood legal & finance will commit to issuing credit notes within 30 days of receiving sufficient proof of statutory withholding. Grace — please confirm process and SLA for issuing credit notes.
4) PO & line items: we will include a PO number field and pricing-bucket line mapping in the Order Form.

Next steps: Kim to update redlines to reflect the agreed commitments, then I will send the Order Form to the DocuSign link and share the HubSpot deal update. Requesting Procurement to provide the formal PO number once we publish the final Order Form.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/abcd-1234-efgh
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

If no further redlines from procurement by EOD Monday, we will push for signature.

Cheers,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
